concerns.text: No task creates `data/raw/synthetic_fatigue.csv`. Plan Phase 1 assigns `src/data/gen_synthetic.py` (seed 42, 10 000 rows) to produce it, but T001 only checksums the file and T002 only loads it as a bundled raw input. An implementer executing the task list on a fresh checkout cannot run T001/T002 — the input file has no producing task. Add a task (or extend T001) to implement and run the deterministic generator.

T006 states 'no arbitrary ≥10 % significance threshold decides meaningfulness' and reports the MAPE reduction descriptively only. Constitution Principle VII requires that models CLAIMING improved predictive value (≥10 % lower MAPE) via stress-mediated features MUST demonstrate this consistently across the held-out set and via paired t-tests. As written, T006's verification cannot confirm a constitution-mandated check; the task must either apply the ≥10 % consistency check when any improvement claim is made, or the constitution must be amended — a task cannot simply opt out.

T004 restricts balanced Sets A/B to the measured-stress subset but inherits the plan's unresolved contradiction: down-sample to 'a balanced number of steel and aluminum rows' while 'maintaining the original proportion'. These are incompatible unless the data is already balanced, so the implementer cannot deterministically construct the subset. T004 must state the exact rule (e.g., equal steel/aluminum counts via seed-42 down-sampling, or original proportions with no down-sampling).

Under the verified scope (only synthetic + verification sources exist), T008's eligibility gate will always emit skip_mediation=true, so FR-006/FR-007 have no executing path. T009's skip-row handling is executable and honest, but T013 amends only FR-003 and FR-001 — it does not amend FR-006/FR-007 to authorize the conditional-skip outcome. Extend T013 (or add a clause) so the spec records that mediation is conditional on a real measured-stress source, otherwise the tasks permanently contradict the spec they implement.
